summary: Backend-only testing for Portuguese ATA meeting management app. Ran 22 pytest cases via /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. 21 passed, 1 skipped (deliberation patch — skipped only because the AI legitimately returned 'Sem deliberação registrada.' for a finalize call with no real transcription, which the backend correctly skips persisting). All auth, dashboard, meeting CRUD, search, AI finalize (GPT-5.2), generate-ata (WOW), PDF/DOCX exports, deliberations list, templates, and cascade-delete flows work as specified.

minor.issue: Accepts raw dict payload with no Pydantic validation — clients can set arbitrary fields including user_id/meeting_id. Recommend a DeliberationUpdate model restricting to {status, responsible, deadline}.
Deliberation persisted record includes user_id but the Pydantic Deliberation model does not declare user_id. Works because raw dict is inserted, but model is inconsistent with stored doc.
html_to_text strips structural HTML (h2/h3/ul) into flat paragraphs — exports lose heading hierarchy and list bullets formatting from AI-generated ata_content.

action_items: Add Pydantic model for PATCH /api/deliberations/{id} to whitelist updatable fields.
Align Deliberation Pydantic model with stored docs (add user_id field) or remove user_id from stored doc consistently.
Consider richer HTML→PDF/DOCX rendering (preserve headings/lists) for ata exports.
critical_code_review_comments: JWT_SECRET default in .env is 'change_me_...' placeholder — fine for dev but flag for prod.
EmailStr in pydantic v2 requires email-validator (already works — confirmed via register endpoint).
next_meeting_number is not race-safe under concurrent creates (two concurrent POSTs could get same number); consider atomic findOneAndUpdate counter or unique index on (user_id, number).
delete_meeting returns 200 ok even if meeting doesn't exist (no 404) — silent success can mask UI bugs.
All endpoints correctly exclude MongoDB _id via projection. Good.
seed_data_creation: Each run registers two fresh users (main + 'other' for cross-user 404 test) and cleans up the created meeting via DELETE. Deliberations cascaded on delete verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is healthy. Test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — reusable, idempotent (timestamp-suffixed emails). AI endpoints (finalize, generate-ata) take 5–25s each; timeouts set to 90/120s. For frontend testing, login flow uses POST /api/auth/login returning {token, user}. Use Bearer token for all subsequent calls. Public base URL: https://ata-auto-gen.preview.emergentagent.com/api.
